column2: Retain Demetrius hearing of defeat and sending Bacchides/Alcimus again with the right wing. Again is explicitly supported by a second-time expression, and wing renders the military horn idiom.
Retain the Gilgal route, Mesaloth in Arbela, capture and many human lives destroyed. Lives expresses souls of people contextually without narrowing the victims to soldiers.
Retain the first month of year 152 and encampment against Jerusalem. No calendar conversion or chronological reconciliation is imposed.
Retain Berea, twenty thousand men and two thousand cavalry. The city name remains the selected provisional form without modern identification.
Retain Elasa and three thousand chosen men with Judas. The selection adjective and initial total remain before the desertion account.
Retain repeated awareness of the enemy’s numbers, extreme fear, many slipping away and only eight hundred remaining. Only is expressly supported by the except construction.
Retain the army draining away, pressure of battle, crushed heart and no time to regather. The bodily image preserves the account’s depiction of Judas’s distress.
Retain faintness and the tentative if perhaps we can fight. His exhortation is not changed into certainty of victory.
Propose Let us return for We will return, preserving the exhortative form in the soldiers’ suggested plan. Keep emphatic inability, saving lives now, return with brothers and their present fewness.

Retain Far be it without inserting God, their approaching time, courageous death for brothers and no charge against glory. The idiomatic charge/reputation relation remains provisional rather than being replaced by a theological assertion.
Retain the force’s deployment, two cavalry parts, forward slingers/archers, mighty foremost fighters and Bacchides on the right. No modern tactical formation is substituted for the listed sequence.
Retain the phalanx approaching from both sides and reciprocal trumpet sounding. Judas’s response remains explicitly a separate group’s action.
Retain earth shaken by army sound and battle from morning to evening. The image is not turned into an independent earthquake report.
Retain Bacchides and the army’s strongest part on the right, and all courageous-in-heart men gathering to Judas. Heart remains audible rather than a generic troop classification.
Retain the right wing’s defeat and singular pursuit to Mount Azotus. The unusual place designation is not corrected to a presumed alternative location.
Retain the left wing’s reaction and pursuit on Judas’s heels from behind. The repeated rearward orientation is not removed as redundant.
Retain the battle becoming heavy and many wounded from both groups. Wounded does not mean every fallen person was killed.
Retain the terse Judas fell and the others fled. The brevity is part of the narrative; no final speech or manner of death is supplied.
Retain Jonathan and Simon lifting/burying their brother in his fathers’ tomb at Modein. The plural brothers and ancestral location remain.
Retain weeping, all Israel’s great lament and mourning for many days. The successive expressions of grief are not collapsed into a single generic funeral notice.
Retain the mighty one’s fall and his saving role toward Israel, in two lament lines. Saviour remains lowercase for this human description and does not imply a divine identity.
Retain the unrecorded remainder of deeds, battles, bravery and greatness because they were very many. The unit does not provide or authorize invention of those missing accounts.
Retain emergence of lawless people throughout Israel and all injustice-workers rising after Judas’s death. The paired emergence verbs preserve the change in public power.
Retain the severe famine and the country’s going over to their side. Country is collective for its people and the defections are not converted into a named treaty.
Retain Bacchides selecting ungodly men as masters of the country. The narrator’s moral designation and the grant of control remain.
Retain seeking/searching Judas’s friends, delivery to Bacchides and his punishment/mockery. Both punitive and humiliating actions remain.
Retain unprecedented distress since a prophet was no longer seen among them. Do not supply a last prophet’s name, precise date or later doctrinal conclusion about prophecy.
Retain all Judas’s friends gathering and addressing Jonathan. The term friends is a follower-group description here, not automatically the royal rank.
Retain the absence of a comparable leader to go out/come in against enemies, Bacchides and national opponents. The leadership-motion idiom is preserved rather than expanded into an office title.
Retain now/today, choosing you as replacement ruler and leader, and fighting our war. Ordinary human you applies to Jonathan; both leadership nouns remain.
Retain Jonathan’s acceptance at that time and rising in his brother’s place. The source describes succession without an added coronation.
Retain Bacchides learning and seeking to kill him. The murderous intention is not recast as an already executed arrest.
Retain Jonathan, Simon and all with them fleeing to Tekoa’s wilderness and Asphar’s water/pool. The exact water installation remains provisional, without an invented size or map position.
Retain learning on the sabbath and the entire army coming beyond Jordan. The sabbath phrase attaches to the learning in the printed order; it is not moved solely to the march.

Retain Jonathan as the contextual supplied subject of sending his brother and seeking Nabatean storage for belongings. This is a narrative subject resumption, not an explicit name in the verse’s Greek.
column3: Confirm the resumed subject and the exact function of the brother’s leader designation; the named resolution remains provisional.

column2: Retain Jambri’s sons from Medaba seizing John and all his possessions. The carrying-away conclusion does not itself narrate John’s death, which later blood language presupposes.
Retain the great wedding, bride from Nadabath, noble Canaanite parent and large escort. The bride’s identity is not supplied beyond this lineage description.
Retain remembering John’s blood and hiding beneath mountain cover. The blood image preserves the stated vengeance motive.

Propose restoring behold after raised eyes and seeing, retaining the commotion, baggage and armed musical wedding party. There was supplies natural English for the source’s nominal presentation without creating a separate event.
Retain the ambush, killing, many wounded, survivors fleeing and all spoils. The general killing and specific wounded/survivor descriptions are not forced into one casualty category.
Retain the wedding-to-mourning and music-to-lamentation reversal. Two display lines make the parallel audible without adding an explanatory judgment.
Retain vengeance for their brother’s blood and return to Jordan’s marsh. The place type remains marsh, distinct from the following banks.
Retain Bacchides hearing, sabbath arrival at Jordan’s banks and a large force. The chronology and physical location remain without harmonizing the preceding sabbath notice.
Retain the call to fight for lives and today unlike yesterday/the day before. The time idiom remains naturally expressed without an inserted precise date.
Retain Behold, battle ahead/behind, Jordan water on either side, marsh/thicket and no escape place. The difficult spatial picture is not remapped to a modern tactical diagram.
Retain the plural command to cry to Heaven and rescue from our enemies’ hand. You addresses the soldiers, so sacred Thou would be inappropriate despite the heaven-directed action.
Retain Jonathan’s outstretched hand to strike Bacchides and the latter’s backward avoidance. The English pronoun remains contextually resolved rather than naming an unmentioned third actor.
Retain the leap into Jordan, swimming across and no enemy crossing after them. Enemy supplies the clear contextual subject switch; no bridge or boat is invented.
Retain about one thousand of Bacchides’s men falling that day. The approximate count remains distinct from exact figures elsewhere.
Retain singular return and plural fortress building, the full named list and high walls/gates/bars. Thamnatha-Pharathon follows the inherited treatment of two adjacent name forms provisionally.
column3: Should Thamnatha and Pharathon be treated as one compound location or separate places in this list? No geographical identification is certified.

column2: Retain garrisons installed to act against Israel. The hostile purpose is explicit and not softened into neutral public security.
Retain Beth-zur, Gazara and the citadel, with troops and food stores in them. The three fortification targets and both resources remain.
Retain leaders’ sons as hostages under guard in Jerusalem’s citadel. The sons are not generalized into unspecified political representatives.

Propose restoring the separate tore down the works and began demolition clauses after Alcimus’s order. The inherited began tearing down collapses the selected accomplished-action verb and following beginning verb; preserve the awkward sequence without resolving it by historical reconstruction.
column3: How does the completed tearing-down clause relate to the following beginning? The proposed wording preserves both while leaving the narrative progression open.

column2: Retain Alcimus struck, obstructed work, stopped mouth, paralysis and inability to speak or order his household. No named disease or explicit divine agent is added to the passive.
Retain death at that time with great torment. The narrative’s suffering description is not converted into a diagnosis.
Retain Bacchides’s return after Alcimus’s death and Judah’s quiet for two years. The selected duration is not conflated with the few days of 7:50.
Retain Behold, Jonathan’s quiet confidence and the plan to seize all in one night. This is the conspirators’ proposal, not a guarantee of its success.
Retain their going and conferring with Bacchides. The short sentence does not supply the content of any additional agreement.
Retain a large force, secret letters to all allies, intended seizure and inability because the plan was known. The exposure’s agent is not expressly identified.
Retain about fifty ringleaders seized/killed, with Jonathan’s men as the inherited contextual subject. The Greek has an unexpressed plural subject, not the explicit possessive label.
column3: Is the contextual change to Jonathan’s party secure, or should a closer draft preserve they? The supplied identification remains provisional.

column2: Retain withdrawal to wilderness Beth-basi, singular rebuilding and plural strengthening. The source’s subject changes are not regularized into one continuous plural.
Retain Bacchides’s knowledge, whole force gathered and orders to those from Judea. The recipient group is not automatically equated with all Judean inhabitants.
Retain Beth-basi siege for many days and engines made. No precise siege duration or engine inventory is supplied.
Retain Simon left in the city and Jonathan going into the country, with small number as an idiomatic interpretation of in number. The source lacks an explicit small adjective.
column3: Does in number mean a small/countable band, an organized contingent or another numerical expression? Retain small number only provisionally pending lexical review.

column2: Retain Odomera, his brothers and Phasiron’s sons at their encampment, then plural striking/advancing. The final actions’ subjects and with their forces remain unresolved.
column3: Who begins striking and advances, and does in the forces mean with forces or against an army? The inherited reading is provisional, not a tactical conclusion.

column2: Retain Simon and companions leaving the city and burning the engines. The explicitly named party distinguishes this sortie from Jonathan’s external action.
Retain Bacchides’s defeat and severe pressure because plan/expedition proved empty. Come to nothing naturally expresses the empty-result adjective.
Retain anger toward the advisers, killing many and resolve to return to his land. The retaliation remains attributed to Bacchides, not Jonathan.
Retain Jonathan’s envoys seeking peace and return of captives. The English to return follows the source infinitive without prematurely assigning possession to an unnamed third party.
Retain acceptance, action according to the request and oath of no harm for all days of his life. The repeated pronouns are contextual and the life-span referent remains provisional.
column3: Whose lifetime delimits the oath: Bacchides’s or Jonathan’s? The inherited pronoun avoids a named resolution.

column2: Retain return of earlier Judean captives, departure to his land and no further entry into their territory. The negative recurrence is explicit.
Retain sword ceasing, Jonathan dwelling at Michmash, judging the people and removing ungodly people. The juridical role is not silently replaced by the title king.
